description: FIND-016's fix mechanism is fictional. REQ-T10 (parent-provisioned venue policy), REQ-S2 (invokes run.sh with ANICCA_VENUE_POLICY_PATH=$parent_venue_policy_path), REQ-S3 ('cloud-init writes the policy file to $CHILD_HOME/loops/earn-pm-trade/menu.json BEFORE install.sh runs'), and REQ-S5 (venue policy provisioning) all assert the EXISTING spawn skill consumes ANICCA_VENUE_POLICY_PATH and that cloud-init writes the child menu.json. grep of skills/self/spawn returns ZERO references to ANICCA_VENUE_POLICY_PATH and ZERO references to menu.json. run.sh:143 invokes cloud-init.sh with only two args: "$CHILD_ID" "$CHILD_INBOX" — the venue policy path is never read, never forwarded, never written. SKILL.md:12 env_optional list does not include ANICCA_VENUE_POLICY_PATH. Therefore the autonomous child still cannot enable any real venue through the claimed delegated path; the resolution depends on capabilities the delegated skill does not have, while the spec frames it as 'delegated entirely to the spawn skill' (REQ-S3). FIND-016 remains open.

evidence.snippet: USER_DATA="$("$SKILL_DIR/scripts/cloud-init.sh" "$CHILD_ID" "$CHILD_INBOX")"  # only 2 args; grep skills/self/spawn -> 0 hits for ANICCA_VENUE_POLICY_PATH / menu.json
